notes: DB301V-3.5-2P-GN-S: Integrated panel. Use panels of the same Vmp on J201/J202
DB301V-3.5-2P-GN-S: Cabled panel through a sealed gland; parallel with J201
1812L110/24DR: Panel input fuse, at the connector
AO3401A: Panel reverse-polarity switch: drain to panel, source to SOLAR_IN. VGS max ±12 V: D202 clamp is mandatory
MMSZ5237B: Clamps Q201 gate-source (AO3401A VGS max ±12 V): mandatory
APXG250ARA470MF61G: + to SOLAR_IN; charger input bulk
0402WGF1004TCE: Panel-voltage sense, top (powered by the panel only)
0402WGF1503TCE: Panel-voltage sense, bottom: 8 V reads 1.04 V. 6 V-class panels only (Voc ≤ 10 V at −40 °C, D201)
CL05B104KB54PNC: VG to VCC, not to GND
AO3401A: Charger switching FET; CN3791 drives VCC − 6.3 V, clamped to ≤ 8 V below VCC (CN3791 Rev 1.0 p.7–8)
PMEG4010CEH,115: Series blocker: stops night back-feed through Q202
PMEG4010CEH,115: Catch diode; keep the C203-Q202-D204 loop tiny
SWPA6045S470MT: 47 µH, CN3791 rule L > 5 × (VCC − VBAT) µH
RL1206FR-070R2L: 600 mA charge. Kelvin-route CN3791 pins 7/8 to the pads
CL05B224KO5NNNC: Loop compensation; return to U201 GND

FRC0402F4023TS: MPPT top: Vmp = 1.205 x (1 + R204/R205) = 6.05 V (Europe, cold winter panel). Australian builds or a cabled panel in hot sun: 330 kΩ (≈ 5.2 V; review R2-G4). Recalculate for the chosen panel and record per unit
KT-0603R: Powered from the panel: no night drain. Fit for bring-up; not fitted on deployment units (review R2-P7)
KT-0805G: Powered from the panel. Symbol pins 1 = A, 2 = K. Fit for bring-up; not fitted on deployment units (review R2-P7)
HT7533-1: Panel-powered supply for the cut-out
CL05B104KB54PNC: U203 VDD bypass, at U203 pin 5
TMP390A2DRLR: Place to sense the battery cells, not a hot regulator. Supplied from U208 so its POR and SET-resistor read happen on a clean edge at ≥ 2.85 V (SBOS904A §7.3; second review R2-P1)
MAX809STRG (onsemi): 2.93 V push-pull reset (2.85–3.00 V, −40…+85 °C). Switches U203 VDD on with a clean edge once TEMP_3V3 is up (review R2-P1, owner decision 2026-11-19)
Push-pull output: low below threshold (U203 off, TEMP_FAULT_N low, MPPT clamped), VCC after 140 ms above it. VOH ≥ 0.8 VCC at 500 µA
0402WGF1872TCE: Cold trip +5 °C, reset +10 °C (owner decision 2026-11-17; was 21.5 kΩ = 0 °C)
0402WGF4702TCE: Open-drain pull-up, 47 kΩ to TEMP_VDD (was 10 kΩ to TEMP_3V3): keeps U208 inside its 500 µA output rating, and an unpowered U203 reads as a fault
MMBT3904: On when temperature is OK: releases the clamp
MMBT3904: Pulls MPPT low to stop charging when too cold/hot
XY-S2B-PH-SM4-TB (JST PH compatible): FieldMesh Node v4 pack, protected 1S2P 18650, ~5200 mAh. Check polarity on every pack batch
Mounting pad (symbol and footprint pad 3) to GND
1812L200THPR: hold 1.50 A at 60 °C, 1.29 A at 85 °C (modem bursts ≈ 1 A); trip 3.5 A at 20 °C
AO3401A: Battery path FET (Node v4 Q5). Does not block a reversed pack while the panel is live
DNP: not needed, R214 holds the gate at GND (saves 3.8 µA)
0603WAF2203T5E: Battery sense on the switched rail: no sleep drain
CL10A106KP8NNNC: at U204 pin 3 (TPL720: ≥ 1 µF at IN, Rev A.2 'Input Capacitor')

DS3231MZ+TRL: ADR-002. Write INTCN=1, BBSQW=0 and EN32KHZ=0 at every boot. INT/SQW drives WAKE_N directly (open drain, pull-up to ≤ 5.5 V allowed regardless of VCC; inverter Q206/Q207 removed, owner decision 2026-11-19, review P22)
CR1220-2: pad 1 = + (EasyEDA footprint marks + at pad 1, − at pad 2; maker drawing not obtained: meter-check the first board before fitting U205)
0402B102K500NT: 1 nF VBAT contact-bounce filter (DS3231M: 0.1–1 nF). Fit the CR1220 after the main pack
2N7002: USB plugged in keeps the board on for service
VBUS divider with R226: 4.5 V on Q209's gate at 5 V (2N7002 Vth up to 2.5 V)
1N4148WS: a button press pulls LATCH_LOGIC to ≈ 0.6 V through D206. Silicon, not Schottky: ≤ 1 µA leakage keeps BTN_N high when hot (review R2-G2)
0402WGF1004TCE: BTN_N pull-up to RAW_BAT: D206 carries no current while idle; 4 µA only while pressed
2N7002: button sense. Released: on, BTN_SENSE low. Pressed: off, BTN_SENSE pulled up by GPIO35. Only sinks, so nothing back-feeds the unpowered MCU

PTS810SJG250SMTRLFS: Hold until firmware asserts PWR_HOLD. Pins 1–2 and 3–4 are joined inside (C&K drawing). Pulls LATCH_LOGIC low through D206; the MCU reads it on BTN_SENSE (owner decision 2026-11-19, review R2-G2)
SSSS811101: Open = board can never turn on (storage, shipping). Pin 2 is the common (ALPS circuit diagram)
Holds the main switch off. 47 kΩ so SW202 carries ≥ 64 µA while awake (ALPS minimum load 50 µA at 3 V); costs nothing asleep
0402WGF0000TCE: Q210 gate link (0 Ω). For a soft start fit 10 kΩ with C237 100 nF and C218 2.2 µF: ≈ 1.2 A for ≈ 1.8 ms instead of ≈ 9 A (review R2-G3)
CL10B473KB8NNNC: gate–source: holds Q210 off at battery connect and delays turn-off. For a soft start (C237 fitted) raise to 2.2 µF so C218 ≫ C237 keeps VGS ≈ 0 at battery hot-plug
DNP: Q210 gate–drain (Miller) capacitor for a soft start; fit 100 nF only together with R245 10 kΩ and C218 2.2 µF
RVT1C471M0607: + to VBAT_SW; bulk for radio peaks

TPS63802DLAR: Node v4 rail (ADR-008). EN from R241/R242: on above 2.68–2.83 V, off below 2.43–2.58 V (precise EN, SLVSEU9D §9.3.2; review R2-G1). PG (pin 5) holds the ESP32 EN low until 3V3 > 95 % (pull-up R401 on the MCU sheet)
0402WGF1503TCE: U206 EN divider top: UVLO on 1.1 V × 2.5 = 2.75 V, off 1.0 V × 2.5 = 2.50 V (review R2-G1)
0402WGF1003TCE: U206 EN divider bottom. 17 µA while awake, none while off
DNP 0 Ω: lets GPIO36 select forced PWM during recordings if G2 finds power-save tones in the audio (review R2-G6)
Series resistor on EN (TPS63020 EN has no soft-start function; the converter soft-starts internally)
0402WGF1003TCE: PS/SYNC high = forced PWM (low ripple for the radio)
Power-good pull-up to MCU: 1 MΩ (TPS63020 PG low level is specified at 10 µA, SLVS916I §6.5; 10 kΩ would sink 330 µA). PG flags current limit; read it only with MODEM_EN high
CL10A226MP8NUNE: at U207 VIN pins 10/11 (TI Fig. 7 uses 2 × 10 µF)
CL05B104KO5NNNC: at U207 pin 1 (VINA), return to pin 2 (SLVS916I §8.2.2.5: 0.1 µF at VINA)
RVT1C471M0607: + to VMODEM; place at the modem
DNP: SMAJ5.0A clamps above the module's 6 V absolute maximum; footprint kept for a ≤ 4.7 V VRWM part
Test pad: wake line (RTC INT, PWR_HOLD, USB)
TMP390 trip test (SBOS904A §7.3.2): drive > 0.8 × VDD and OUTA goes low; charging must stop (review R2-P2)
